edit.hideEffect: Excluded from balances and reports until shown again.
edit.hideEffectLinked: Excluded from balances and reports until shown again. Ends the link with {account}.
edit.deleteEffectKeepsLinked: The booking on {account} stays. This cannot be undone.
edit.deleteEffectLinked: Also deletes the booking on {account}. This cannot be undone.
edit.frozen: {account} is archived, so this booking keeps its amount, date and balance effect. Its category, split, payee and description can still change, and an imported booking can be linked with an existing booking or unlinked.
edit.frozenLinked: The linked account is archived, so this booking keeps its amount, date and balance effect. Its category, split, payee and description can still change, and an imported booking can be linked with an existing booking or unlinked.
edit.counterpartHint: Bookings with the opposite amount within two weeks, or a new counterpart.
edit.noCounterpartOutgoing: Transfer to an account not tracked in Ufer.
edit.noCounterpartIncoming: Transfer from an account not tracked in Ufer.
